endpoints.summary: Discover and list all Bitbucket projects you have access to.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: number of projects to return (default 25, max 1000)

endpoints.summary: Browse and discover repositories within a project.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: number of repositories to return (default 25, max 1000)

endpoints.summary: Create a new pull request. Send the PR body (title, description, fromRef, toRef, reviewers) as raw JSON in the body field.

parameters.name: repositorySlug
parameters.description: the repository slug where the PR is created

endpoints.summary: Retrieve detailed information about a pull request. Requires the pullRequestId, discoverable via listRepositories and the PR list.

parameters.name: repositorySlug
parameters.description: the repository slug containing the PR

endpoints.summary: Merge an approved pull request. Provide version, message and strategy as raw JSON in the body field. Requires the pullRequestId of an approved, mergeable PR.

parameters.name: repositorySlug
parameters.description: the repository slug containing the PR

parameters.name: pullRequestId
parameters.description: the pull request ID to merge

endpoints.summary: Decline a pull request. Provide version and message as raw JSON in the body field. Requires the pullRequestId of the target PR.

parameters.name: repositorySlug
parameters.description: the repository slug containing the PR

parameters.name: pullRequestId
parameters.description: the pull request ID to decline

endpoints.summary: Add a comment to a pull request. Provide text (and optional parent) as raw JSON in the body field. Requires the pullRequestId of the target PR.

parameters.name: repositorySlug
parameters.description: the repository slug containing the PR

parameters.name: pullRequestId
parameters.description: the pull request ID to comment on

endpoints.summary: Add an inline comment anchored to a diff line in a pull request. Provide text plus an anchor (path, line, lineType, diffType, fileType) as raw JSON in the body field. Requires the pullRequestId and a valid diff anchor (path, line, lineType).

parameters.name: repositorySlug
parameters.description: the repository slug containing the PR

parameters.name: pullRequestId
parameters.description: the pull request ID to comment on

endpoints.summary: Retrieve the diff for a pull request. Requires the pullRequestId of the target PR.

parameters.name: repositorySlug
parameters.description: the repository slug containing the PR

parameters.name: pullRequestId
parameters.description: the pull request ID to get the diff for

endpoints.summary: Fetch the PR activity timeline; use this to inspect review/approval activity (client filters for APPROVED/REVIEWED). Requires the pullRequestId of the target PR.

parameters.name: repositorySlug
parameters.description: the repository slug containing the PR

parameters.name: pullRequestId
parameters.description: the pull request ID to get reviews for

endpoints.summary: Retrieve the full activity timeline for a pull request (comments, reviews, updates). Requires the pullRequestId of the target PR.

parameters.name: repositorySlug
parameters.description: the repository slug containing the PR

parameters.name: pullRequestId
parameters.description: the pull request ID to get activities for

endpoints.summary: Fetch the PR activity timeline; use this to inspect comments (client filters for COMMENTED). Requires the pullRequestId of the target PR.

parameters.name: repositorySlug
parameters.description: the repository slug containing the PR

parameters.name: pullRequestId
parameters.description: the pull request ID to get comments for

endpoints.summary: Search for code or files across repositories. Provide the query and entities (code start/limit) as raw JSON in the body field. NOTE: this endpoint lives under /rest/search/latest, not /rest/api/1.0, and requires the Bitbucket code-search plugin.
Retrieve file contents with pagination. Set the branch/commit via the at query param.

parameters.name: repositorySlug
parameters.description: the repository slug containing the file

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: the file path within the repository

endpoints.summary: Browse files and directories at the repository root. Set the branch/commit via the at query param.
Create a new repository in a project. Provide name, scmId and options as raw JSON in the body field.
Delete a repository from a project. This action is irreversible.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: number of branches to return (default 25, max 1000)
